title: The Imperfect Subjunctive After a Past Verb

sections.content:
You know the imperfect subjunctive forms (*si tuviera*, *si yo fuera tú*) from B1 Unit 4, and the present subjunctive after wishes and advice (*quiero que vengas*) from A2 Unit 27 and B1 Unit 4. New here: when the main verb is in the past, the verb after *que* is in the imperfect subjunctive too:

• Present: *Quiero que vengas.* (I want you to come.)
• Imperfect: *Quería que vinieras.* (I wanted you to come.)
• *Indefinido*: *Me pidió que le ayudara.* (He asked me to help him.)
• Conditional: *Me encantaría que vinieras.* (I would love you to come.)

items.spanish: Mis padres querían que yo estudiara medicina.
items.english: My parents wanted me to study medicine.

items.spanish: El médico me recomendó que guardara reposo.
items.english: The doctor recommended that I get some rest.

items.spanish: Me alegré mucho de que estuvieras en la ceremonia.
items.english: I was very glad that you were at the ceremony.

sections.content: With a past main verb the subjunctive after *que* is normally the imperfect: *Quería que viniera*, not *Quería que venga*.
